title: audio block props
description: An audio file (narration, interview, ambiance) the learner plays, with its transcript unless it is decorative.
x-ai-instructions: Do not duplicate the narration as on-screen text (E4). A transcript is mandatory for a sound that carries information (F3); an ambiance or music that carries none is decorative: true. No autoplay.

transcript.description: What is said, for those who cannot hear it. Required unless decorative.

decorative.description: True only if the sound carries no information (an ambiance, music): no transcript. The learner still starts it.
